name: Chesapeake Spice
old_description: Operating since 1987, Chesapeake Spice, a family-owned business, has flourished by advancing technology, hiring key personnel with industry knowledge and experience, and continually expanding and improving both manufacturing facilities which are located strategically on the east and west coasts.
about:
Chesapeake Spice was founded in 1987 as a family-owned business in Reno, Nevada. The company began with a focus on spice production and has since expanded its operations to include manufacturing facilities on both the East and West coasts.

The company produces a range of spices and organic-certified products. Its manufacturing footprint includes two strategically located facilities, with the West Coast plant recently becoming operational. The operation emphasizes advancing technology and hiring personnel with deep industry experience to maintain quality across its product lines.

Chesapeake Spice serves the food manufacturing, seasoning, and organic food sectors. Its products are used by food processors and brands seeking consistent spice blends and organic compliance. The company’s Maryland Department of Agriculture organic certification allows it to meet the growing demand for certified organic ingredients.

The business distinguishes itself through continuous investment in facility upgrades, a family-ownership model that prioritizes long-term quality, and certifications including BRC and Maryland organic standards. These elements reflect its founding philosophy of combining technological advancement with experienced personnel to exceed customer expectations.
